name: stop_background_music

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_StopBackgroundMusic takes no Script context and does not access the value stack

notes: ScriptCommand_StopBackgroundMusic first calls func_0011E340, which sets D_002BD8E0 and prevents the regular music-state update func_0011E360 from starting a replacement track. It then calls func_0011C608 for music channels 0 and 1; that wrapper submits sound RPC operation 13, the same channel-stop operation used before loading replacement music. The JP corpus contains 13 calls across five archives, predominantly at cinematic entry points; seven calls are the first instruction of an entry, and two are immediately preceded by a 40-tick music fade through command 427.
